plan.notes: Official CSUDH Academic Catalog 2025-2026, Political Science B.A. program page, 'Political Theory Concentration' 4-Year Roadmap (Plan of Study Grid), Total Hours 120. All semester sums reconcile with printed Hours (15+16+15+15+15+15+15+14=120). 'Political Theory Concentration Course (see catalog)' rows modeled as choice slots referencing the concentration's catalog course list (POL 319, 351, 352, 354, 355, 356, 357; courses used for Depth in Political Science may not be double-counted per catalog). Spring of Fourth Year includes a genuine 2-unit 'Elective to meet 120 units' (3+3+3+3+2=14 as printed). POL 300 satisfies the GWAR requirement. Prereq arrays empty: the roadmap publishes no per-course prerequisites and none are invented.
